ActorFrame.children: <Layer File="_GlitchSounds.xml" OnCommand="queuecommand,Pulse" PulseCommand="%function(self) ModPulse(self,'randomvanish') end" ModCommand="%function(self) if ITGMeatGlob.world < 6 then ITGMeatGlob.warp = math.mod(ITGMeatGlob.warp + 1,4) elseif ITGMeatGlob.world == 6 then ITGMeatGlob.warp = math.mod(ITGMeatGlob.warp + 1 + ((ITGMeatGlob.warp == 1 and 1) or 0),4); else ITGMeatGlob.warp = 0 end if ITGMeatGlob.warp == 1 then Sound('chapterend.ogg') elseif ITGMeatGlob.warp == 2 then Sound('WarpZone.ogg') elseif ITGMeatGlob.warp == 3 then self:queuecommand('Glitch') else Sound('dundundun') end end" />
